title: Menos comercio, menos ingresos
goal: Read how the trade collapse became a fiscal crisis for customs-dependent Latin American states, leaving newly built armies and rural schools unfunded.

items: State what historians agree the Great Depression was for Latin America.
Explain what happened to the region's foreign trade volume between 1929 and 1932.
Explain why the trade collapse translated directly into a severe fiscal crisis.
Describe what several governments could no longer afford to do.
Use the superlative pattern la peor... que... jamás to make a strong historical claim.
